clips.title: ClientVantage KT — Creating a New Client Account

steps.title: Open Clients
steps.detail: Start from the Clients workspace and review the existing account list.

steps.title: Start a new account
steps.detail: Choose New Client Account to open the guided account form.

steps.title: Enter client details
steps.detail: Add the legal name, primary contact email, and account tier.

steps.title: Choose a template
steps.detail: Match the onboarding template to the client’s industry.

steps.title: Save a draft
steps.detail: Save first so the details can be checked before submission.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.detail: Confirm the summary, then send it to a Client Success Lead.

steps.title: Activate the account
steps.detail: After approval, the account moves from Draft to Active.

clips.title: ClientVantage KT — Updating Client Account Status

steps.title: Find the client
steps.detail: Open the account from the Clients list before changing its state.

steps.title: Edit status
steps.detail: Select Edit Status to review the available account states.

steps.title: Choose a status
steps.detail: Set Pending, Active, Suspended, or Closed as needed.

steps.title: Add a closure reason
steps.detail: A Closed account needs a clear reason in the notes field.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.detail: Apply the update and confirm the new state on the account.

steps.title: Request approval
steps.detail: Suspended and Closed changes wait for a Client Success Lead.

steps.title: Check the audit log
steps.detail: Every change records who acted, when, and why.

clips.title: SupplyLine KT — Creating a Purchase Order

steps.title: Open Purchase Orders
steps.detail: Start from the Purchase Orders tab in SupplyLine.

steps.title: Create a new PO
steps.detail: Choose New Purchase Order to begin a draft.

steps.title: Select a vendor
steps.detail: Use the vendor directory or add a new approved vendor.

steps.title: Add line items
steps.detail: Enter each item description, quantity, and unit price.

steps.title: Set delivery details
steps.detail: Choose the destination and requested delivery date.

steps.title: Submit for review
steps.detail: Send the purchase order to a Procurement Approver.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.detail: The status moves from Draft to Pending Approval, then Approved.

clips.title: SupplyLine KT — Approving and Updating Purchase Order Status

steps.title: Open pending approvals
steps.detail: Choose a purchase order from the review queue.

steps.title: Review the order
steps.detail: Check vendor, line items, and total against the budget.

steps.title: Approve or reject
steps.detail: Approve to proceed, or reject with a reason for the requester.

steps.title: Record the outcome
steps.detail: An approval moves the order to Approved; a rejection is recorded.

steps.title: Receive the goods
steps.detail: When items arrive, open the Receiving tab.

steps.title: Mark as Received
steps.detail: Update the status after receipt is confirmed.

steps.title: Respect role controls
steps.detail: Procurement Approvers or Supply Chain Systems admins can decide.
